fed.note_en: October watch. PM exclusive +25bp mid 0.155 vs Altınla CME-method hike-bin 0.413 (gap 25.8pp) — mismatch_flag true (≥~8–10pp). Investing secondary hike=0.184 (gap 2.9pp, below threshold). Both sources quote the same ZQV26 96.115 but map it 22.9pp apart, so the flag rests on one source's day-weight/baseline assumption. Buying the whole NegRisk set costs 1.0271 after 5% fees — no edge. Contracts are not identical (CME 4.00–4.25 bin ≈ PM exclusive +25bp only from current 3.75–4.00). Paper inconsistency mark, not a trade.
fed.note_zh: 十月观察。PM 独家 +25bp mid 0.155 对 Altınla CME 方法加息档 0.413（缺口 25.8 个百分点）——错配标记 true（≥约 8–10pp）。Investing 次源加息档 0.184（缺口 2.9pp，未过阈值）。两个来源报的是同一个 ZQV26 96.115，换算结果却差 22.9pp，所以这个标记取决于单一来源的日权重/基准假设。整组 NegRisk 扣 5% 费后成本 1.0271，无边。合约不完全相同（CME 4.00–4.25 档仅在当前 3.75–4.00 时约等于 PM 独家 +25bp）。只是纸面不一致标记，不是交易。
fed.recheck_en: Re-check if: (1) contracts are definition-matched, AND (2) NegRisk net cost/share < 1 after live feeSchedule, AND (3) the expensive legs still have size, OR |PM−CME gap| ≥ ~8–10pp on matched bins.
fed.recheck_zh: 重检条件：定义对齐，且 NegRisk 扣现费后净成本 < 1，且贵的那几条仍有深度；或对齐档上 |PM−CME| 缺口 ≥ 约 8–10 个百分点。

method.en: Audit, not a teaser. Scan exclusive NegRisk Yes-asks; reject any incomplete partition; apply that market’s feeSchedule.rate (fee = C × rate × p × (1−p); rebate ignored). A Fed gap counts only if contracts are definition-matched. Scorecards freeze T−2h modal Yes mid vs BLS first print. Book depth: both sides walked at $50–$1000 per set with ±1-tick stress, min order (shares, and $1 per buy leg) enforced after rounding, sets all-or-nothing, stale reads rejected; a passing row is a snapshot size check, not a fill guarantee (depth_check, v2.3). Engine stays private; every number on this page is in desk.json.
method.zh: 这是审计，不是预告页。扫互斥 NegRisk 的 Yes 卖一；分区不完整就否；用该市场 feeSchedule.rate（fee = C × rate × p × (1−p)，忽略返佣）。利率缺口只在定义对齐时才算。记分卡用 T−2h 众数 Yes mid 对 BLS 首次。盘口深度：买卖双向按每组 $50–$1000 回溯并做 ±1 价位压力，取整后强制最小下单量（股数，买入腿另需 $1），整组全有或全无，过时读取即否；通过的档只是快照规模检查，不保证成交（depth_check，v2.3）。引擎不公开；这页每个数都在 desk.json。

depth_check.line_en: Book depth checked both sides at $50–$1000 (as of 2026-10-08 19:15 CST)
depth_check.method_en: v2.3. A passing row is a size check on one snapshot, not a fill guarantee. BUY: equal shares of every leg down the public CLOB asks until the stake (incl. fees) is spent; edge iff cost/set < $1. SELL: mint $1 full sets and sell every leg down the bids; edge iff proceeds/set > $1. SELL counts the $1 mint cost per set. Min order size enforced after rounding; sets all-or-nothing: shares per set are rounded down to 0.01 and a set at a stake is REJECTED with a code — REJECTED_MIN_ORDER (a leg below its book min_order_size in shares, or a BUY leg under $1 notional), REJECTED_DEPTH (visible depth short of the full count), REJECTED_STALE (leg reads more than 5 s apart), REJECTED_BOOK (crossed book or market not accepting orders); max_profitable only counts complete sets meeting every minimum. Fee per level fill = shares × feeSchedule.rate × p(1−p), rounded to 5 dp. Ladder $50/$100/$250/$500/$1000. max_profitable = size where the marginal set crosses $1 after fees (edge-maximising size); breakeven = size where the average crosses $1. Tick stress: every leg fills 1 tick worse (+1 tick on asks, −1 on bids at that market's tick size) — legs are not executed atomically, so this is the buffer left for non-atomic execution.
depth_check.method_zh: v2.3。通过的档只是对一次快照的规模检查，不保证成交。买方：沿公开 CLOB 卖单每条腿买相同股数，直到本金（含费）花完；每组成本 < $1 才算优势。卖方：以每组 $1 铸造整组，每条腿沿买单卖出；每组所得 > $1 才算优势。卖方计入每组 $1 铸造成本。取整后强制最小下单量；整组全有或全无：每组股数向下取整到 0.01，被否的档写明代码——REJECTED_MIN_ORDER（某腿低于盘口 min_order_size 股数，或买入腿名义金额不足 $1）、REJECTED_DEPTH（可见深度不够全部股数）、REJECTED_STALE（各腿读取相隔超过 5 秒）、REJECTED_BOOK（盘口交叉或市场不接单）；max_profitable 只计每条腿都满足最小量的完整组。每个价位成交的费用 = 股数 × feeSchedule.rate × p(1−p)，取整到 5 位小数。阶梯 $50/$100/$250/$500/$1000。max_profitable = 扣费后边际一组越过 $1 时的规模（净额最大）；breakeven = 平均成本越过 $1 时的规模。价位压力：每条腿成交价差一个价位（卖单 +1 tick、买单 −1 tick，按该市场 tick）——各腿并非原子成交，这是给非原子执行留的缓冲。
depth_check.execution_note_en: A passing row is a size check on one book snapshot, not a fill guarantee. The legs of a set are read within 5 s in one batch, but would be sent as separate orders, so the books can move between them (legging risk).
depth_check.execution_note_zh: 通过的档只是对一次盘口快照的规模检查，不保证成交。同一组各腿在 5 秒内一次批量读取，但下单时是分开的订单，各腿之间盘口可能变动（腿部风险）。
depth_check.legging_model_en: Legging column: only the single worst leg fills k ticks worse than its snapshot book (other legs at the snapshot). "+1 tick, worst leg" = extra cost (buy) or lost proceeds (sell) per set at k = 1; "break-even ticks" = the largest k that still leaves edge > 0 — n/a when the row has no edge, with the edge shown in worst-leg ticks (negative = the row already has no edge).
depth_check.legging_model_zh: 腿部风险列：只有最差的一条腿比快照盘口差 k 个价位成交（其余腿按快照）。“最差腿 +1 tick” = k = 1 时每组多付的成本（买）或少得的所得（卖）；“盈亏平衡 tick” = 仍保有正优势的最大 k——该档没有优势时为 n/a，并以最差腿 tick 数显示优势（负数 = 该档已无优势）。

negrisk.buy_en: Buy one Yes of every leg on the asks. If the set is exhaustive exactly one leg pays $1 at resolution (capital locked until then).
negrisk.buy_zh: 在卖单上买入每条腿各 1 股 Yes。集合穷尽时恰好一条腿在结算时付 $1（资金锁到结算）。
negrisk.sell_en: Mint full Yes sets for $1 each (split $1 in every market, convert the No tokens back via the NegRisk adapter; or equivalently buy every No on its asks, which pays ≥ n−1), then sell each Yes leg down the bids. Proceeds > $1/set after fees = edge. Works even if the set is not exhaustive. All-or-nothing: if any leg cannot sell the full share count on visible bids (or is below its min order), the set is rejected; gas not counted.
negrisk.sell_zh: 以每组 $1 铸造整组 Yes（在每个市场拆分 $1，再经 NegRisk 适配器把 No 换回；等价于在卖单上买齐所有 No，到期至少付 n−1），然后每条 Yes 腿沿买单卖出。扣费后每组所得 > $1 才算优势。集合不穷尽也成立。全有或全无：任何一条腿无法在可见买单上卖完全部股数（或低于最小下单量），该组即被否；不计 gas。

binary.buy_en: Buy Yes + No on the asks, merge for $1 immediately.
binary.buy_zh: 在卖单上买 Yes + No，可立即合并换回 $1。
binary.sell_en: Split $1 into Yes + No, sell both on the bids. On Polymarket the Yes and No books of one market are the same book mirrored (Yes bid p = No ask 1−p), so this is structurally 1 − spread − fees and cannot exceed $1; buying is 1 + spread + fees. Not an applicable edge test, shown for completeness.
binary.sell_zh: 拆分 $1 得 Yes + No，在买单上卖出两者。Polymarket 同一市场的 Yes 与 No 是同一本盘口的镜像（Yes 买价 p = No 卖价 1−p），所以结构上只能是 1 − 价差 − 费，不可能超过 $1；买入则是 1 + 价差 + 费。不是有效的优势检验，仅为完整列出。

depth_check.timestamps_note_en: Per set: first/last leg book read (local receive time, CST to the second) and their spread in ms — legs of a set are read in one batch request; spread > 5 s rejects the set (REJECTED_STALE). Server book timestamp (CLOB "timestamp") oldest/newest is the time of the last book change, so on quiet books it can be minutes older than the read; shown, not used to reject.
depth_check.timestamps_note_zh: 每组：最早/最晚一条腿的盘口读取时间（本地接收时间，CST 精确到秒）及其间隔毫秒——同一组各腿用一次批量请求读取；间隔超过 5 秒即判该组过时（REJECTED_STALE）。服务器盘口时间戳（CLOB "timestamp"）最旧/最新是盘口最后一次变动时间，冷清盘口可能比读取早几分钟；只显示，不用于否决。
limits_en: Not a fill guarantee: a passing row is a size check on one book snapshot. Legs would be sent as separate orders, so books can move between them; the legging column moves only the single worst leg by k ticks — several legs moving, liquidity being pulled, or order latency/matching delay can be worse.

Single snapshot per run; the legs of one set are read in one batch request. A set whose leg reads are more than 5 s apart is rejected as stale (REJECTED_STALE). The CLOB book "timestamp" is the time of the last book change (unchanged on refetch), so an old one on a quiet book is shown but not treated as stale.

Legs are not executed atomically: each leg is a separate CLOB order, so later legs can fill worse (see ±1 tick stress; stress prices stay inside [tick, 1 − tick] at the tick read with the book — a tick-size change near 0/1 before the fill is not modelled).
Public CLOB order books only: no hidden, off-book or RFQ liquidity; no queue position or partial-fill modelling.

Fees: feeSchedule.rate × p(1−p) (rate re-read from gamma at book time), rounded to 5 dp per price level; a level holding several maker orders is several fills, so true rounding can differ by < $0.00001 per fill. Maker rebates and gas ignored.

Sell side counts $1 mint cost per set (split; NegRisk convert assumed fee-free — not read on-chain); proceeds must exceed it after fees. Buy-side edge on a non-exhaustive set is nominal; NegRisk buy-side value is only realised at resolution.

Minimums after rounding, all-or-nothing: shares per set rounded down to 0.01; a set is rejected (leg + reason) if any leg is below its book min_order_size (shares), any BUY leg is under $1 notional (CLOB rejects marketable BUYs below $1; for SELL legs that rule is not confirmed, so it is only flagged; resting limit legs and padding cheap legs above the set size are not modelled), any leg lacks depth for the full count, or a leg book is crossed / not accepting orders — never a partial fill. USD-amount rounding is not modelled.
limits_zh: 不保证成交：通过的档只是对一次盘口快照的规模检查。各腿下单是分开的订单，期间盘口可能变动；腿部风险列只让最差的一条腿差 k 个价位——多条腿同时变动、挂单被撤、下单延迟或撮合延迟都可能更糟。
每次运行只读一次快照；同一组的各条腿用一次批量请求读取。若一组各腿读取时间相差超过 5 秒，判为过时（REJECTED_STALE）。CLOB 盘口 "timestamp" 是盘口最后一次变动的时间（重复读取不变），冷清盘口时间戳较旧只做显示，不当作过时。
各条腿不是原子成交：每条腿是独立的 CLOB 订单，后成交的腿可能更差（见 ±1 价位压力；压力价限制在 [tick, 1 − tick]，按读取盘口时的 tick——未模拟成交前在 0/1 附近 tick 变化）。
只看公开 CLOB 盘口：不含隐藏、场外或 RFQ 流动性；不模拟排队和部分成交。
费用：feeSchedule.rate × p(1−p)（读盘口时从 gamma 重新读取费率），按每个价位取整到 5 位小数；一个价位若含多张挂单就是多笔成交，真实取整每笔相差 < $0.00001。忽略做市返佣和 gas。
卖方计入每组 $1 铸造成本（拆分；NegRisk 转换按无费用计——未上链核对）；扣费后所得必须超过它。不穷尽集合的买方优势只是名义值；NegRisk 买方的价值要到结算才实现。
取整后检查最小量，整组全有或全无：每组股数向下取整到 0.01；任何一条腿低于盘口 min_order_size（股）、任何买入腿名义金额不足 $1（CLOB 拒绝低于 $1 的可成交买单；卖出腿未证实有此规则，只做标记；未模拟挂单腿或为凑 $1 多买便宜腿）、深度不够全部股数、或盘口交叉/不接单，该组即被否（写明腿和原因）——绝不记部分成交。未模拟美元金额取整。
